validation_policy: fixed independent development examples; fresh labels at each current LoRA state; no downstream test labels
selection: minimum mean factor-balanced per-example A/B relative MSE plus token-weighted aggregate A/B concatenated relative MSE; include epoch0
calibration_optimizer: AdamW reset per refresh, matching earlier Countdown2; retain selected weights across outer steps
calibration_loss: factor-balanced individual A/B relative MSE + .25 activation MSE normalized by original pretraining target_scale; no aggregate training loss
accuracy_policy: dev curves at scheduled steps, complete test2048 only prespecified endpoints; no test-based tuning; reused benchmark

warmup.initialization: original seed101 random A, zero B, exactly one o_proj adapter per model

offline_predictor.selection: minimum dev factor-balanced A/B relative MSE every epoch
